messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty -> High tail latency observed on /v1/stream (us-west1). Condition: streaming tail > 2s for 5m.

sam (infra-oncall): I'm looking. Datadog shows p95 ~310ms, p99 ~2.7s in the last 5m. Preproc-v2 CPU and request durations up. Grabbing logs + flamegraph.

maya (sre): Reminder: prompt-templater 2.3 rolled at 03:14 introducing JSON-mode tool schema expansion. @diego any early indicators?

diego (runtime): Confirmed. New code path executes full schema expansion for JSON-mode which can explode token count on nested tool schemas. Snippet from logs:
```
I0325 03:15:02.123 prompt-templater.go:228] expanded schema nodes=14 -> tokens=11842
I0325 03:15:02.124 tokenizer.go:87] tokenization duration=372ms tokens=11842
```

katie (eng-ml): JSON-mode flag exists: `prompt.json_mode.enabled`. We can flip to false to stop expansion.

sam (infra-oncall): Rolling feature flag set: `rctl set feature prompt.json_mode.enabled=false --svc=prompt-templater --env=prod`

incident-bot: feature flag rollout started across 6 replicas — expected steady-state ~45s.

nancy (support): Noting customer impact: streaming stalls reported by acme-inc, beta-apps, and 2 other accounts. Support tickets raised.

sam (infra-oncall): After flag change, p99 dropped to ~820ms in ~90s, p95 stable ~270ms. Progressing mitigation.

diego (runtime): Also manually scaled preproc-v2 to 6 replicas and increased CPU requests. Commands: `kubectl scale deploy/preproc-v2 --replicas=6` and `kubectl patch hpa/preproc-v2 -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":12}}'`.

maya (sre): Can someone run an end-to-end repro (streaming) to verify tail latency? Repro steps:
1) `curl -s -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @heavy_schema.json`
2) capture `X-Trace-Id` and inspect trace.

katie (eng-ml): Repro executed; with JSON-mode ON tokenization step ~680ms and end-to-end tail stall reproducible. With JSON-mode OFF, tokenization ~120ms.

sam (infra-oncall): Marking incident mitigated and clearing urgent paging. Handoff to maya for full RCA and follow-up.

maya (sre): Taking over. Immediate action items:
- revert prompt-templater to 2.2 if canary shows regression
- add code guardrail to limit recursive expansion or cap expanded tokens per-request
- add alert: tokenizer.tokenize_time > 150ms -> paging threshold
Owners: diego (templater patch), katie (regression/eval tests), sam (runbook + paging rules).

nancy (support): Customer comms queued. Affected tickets: #12345, #12346, #12347. Severity: S3 (streaming degraded).

diego (runtime): Pushed hotfix PR #4729 to bypass JSON-mode when schema length > 2KB; canarying now. Also adding defensive short-circuit in tokenizer.

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident status -> mitigated. Incident window ~03:14–03:18 UTC. Summary: transient p99 elevation due to prompt-templater JSON-mode expanding large tool schemas causing tokenizer tail latency spikes and streaming stalls.

sam (infra-oncall): Closing live mitigation thread. Follow-ups: RCA doc, schedule postmortem (tomorrow 10:00 UTC), add load tests with heavy tool schemas, merge guardrail and increase test coverage.

maya (sre): Assigning follow-up tickets in backlog.

katie (eng-ml): I'll add an automated eval harness with JSON-mode heavy templates to CI to detect regressions.

nancy (support): Confirmed customers updated. Clearing active alerts.

sam (infra-oncall): Final metrics: p95 260ms, p99 240ms, streaming success rate 99.98%. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:
